reading: core: Shopify says its plan "includes abandoned cart recovery features" (SH-S-7224), its plan table lists Abandoned checkout recovery as Included on every plan (SH-S-7041), and the store entitlement abandonedCartRecovery is true on the stores SH-S-5277 names; Abandoned checkout and POS abandoned checkout are templates of its own Notifications (SH-I-2021, SH-I-2029, placed in SH-C-150, domain D), cited because no statement covers them; that they are the messages to the buyer who left is a reading from their names. extension-point: the App Store category Abandoned cart apps (SH-I-1827), cited because no statement covers it; that its apps recover the sale is a reading from the name. shows: the same entitlement is false on the trial stores SH-S-5276 names. SH-C-050 is domain C in scope.tsv, with D under also (convention 8). Its records statements (the admin path checkouts, the Abandoned checkouts navigation, the section's eligibility, the webhook checkouts/update, the admin extension targets on abandoned checkouts) are left to C. Q1 gap: SH-C-050/reason searched, not found, so no statement says why recovery is built in.
